recipe.name: Sober Bomba(e)
recipe.description: A sour, fruity mocktail of fresh watermelon shaken with spiced kokum cordial and a pinch of black salt.
steps: Muddle the watermelon cubes in a shaker until they are completely juicy.
Add the spiced kokum cordial and the black salt, if using, then shake hard with ice.
Double strain over fresh ice into a rocks glass.
recipe.ice: Shaken with ice; served over fresh ice
